{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float
# Remove commas and convert to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders (status == 'completed')
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Exclude internal test orders
# According to the dictionary, there is no explicit 'test' flag.
# But the note says: "Internal test orders are marked with order_id starting with 'TEST'"
# So we filter out any order_id that starts with 'TEST'
completed_non_test = completed_orders[~completed_orders['order_id'].str.startswith('TEST')]

# Calculate total revenue from completed non-test orders
total_revenue = completed_non_test['revenue'].sum()

# Print result
total_revenue"}
